Principle 23: Daily Life
I have a pretty hectic daily schedule.
I get up at seven o’clock every morning and have breakfast at 7:30 a.m.
I leave for school at about 7:45 a.m.
I meet my friends and play around a little before we go to class.
I have four morning classes that begin at 9 a.m.
After lunch, I have two more classes.
I finish my classes, and then I go to a private academy
where I study art, piano and English.
Sometimes I get tired after attending my academies.
After going to the academy, I go home and have dinner with my family.
My weekdays are pretty busy, too.
My weekdays are similar to other students.
Every night I get home and chat on the computer with my friends.
Nowadays, I am on the computer for a very long time.
My favorite time is Friday because it is the start of the weekend.
The weekend is my most favorite part of the week.
On Saturdays, we only go to school in the morning.
Sometimes if there is a special day like a birthday party,
we celebrate on Saturday afternoons.
We like to go to the karaoke room for these.
Our family often visits the house of my father’s friend.
We sometimes visit our relatives or they come to our house.
I wish every day could be like the weekend.
We have two main school vacations:
one is in the summer, and one in the winter.
During vacation time, we don’t go to public school,
but we still go to private academies.
Even though we still go to the academies,
we have a lot more free time where we can spend more
time doing things we like.
Even though it is vacation, my mother wants me to study more,
so every day she makes me study.
I like vacations because I have more freedom to do what I want
even though I have to study.
